result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with sidewalks on both sides and a large parking garage entrance on the left. While the narrow geometry likely keeps vehicle speeds low, there is a lack of marked pedestrian crossings and potential conflict points at the garage driveway.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Point
hazards.description: The entrance and exit to the multi-level parking garage create a point where vehicles must cross the pedestrian sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, mid-ground

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks for pedestrians to safely traverse the street between blocks.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate safe crossing points for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Warning Treatments
interventions.description: Add visual or tactile warnings at the parking garage exit to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians on the sidewalk.

result.summary: The intersection features wide, well-maintained sidewalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. However, visibility is partially compromised by parked vehicles near the crossing point on the side street.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the side street curb may obstruct the line of sight between pedestrians and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, along the curb of the intersecting street.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Removing parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Expanding the sidewalk at the corner to reduce crossing distance and prevent cars from parking too close to the intersection.

result.summary: The intersection features standard pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and wide sidewalks in good condition. However, the environment lacks physical traffic calming measures such as curb extensions or refuge islands to reduce pedestrian exposure to turning vehicles.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Wide Corner Radii
hazards.description: The lack of curb extensions allows vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and paved sidewalks. However, the sidewalk corner is significantly obstructed by large utility poles and protective metal structures, which impede pedestrian flow and accessibility.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Large metal poles and protective cages occupy a significant portion of the sidewalk corner, narrowing the path for pedestrians and those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground on the sidewalk corner.

hazards.name: Limited Sightlines
hazards.description: The building is situated directly at the corner, which may limit visibility between pedestrians waiting to cross and drivers approaching the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image at the building corner.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearing and Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate or consolidate utility poles and obstructions to provide a clear, unobstructed pedestrian through-zone.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing their visibility in the crosswalk.
